payload.summary: Four dictionary sources record a publisher that is a description, not an agency
payload.detail: WA-MHAS records 'Government of Western Australia', WA-AHLO records 'WA Health service providers', WA-MHERL records 'Mental Health Commission / WA Health' (two publishers in one field), and 4AT-OFFICIAL records '4AT developers'. None was registered in src/lib/source-authority-registry.ts on purpose: a catch-all entry for the Crown would resolve every WA government document to a single authority, which is worse than leaving the records held. Establish the actual publishing agency for each and correct the publisher field, then re-run npm run check:source-acquisitions.
